title.heading: Navi
title.sub: Use Chrome with just your voice
title.narrator: This is Navi: a Chrome extension you use with just your voice.

steps.narrator: It lives in Chrome's side panel. Just talk.
If you can't see the screen, Navi moves through a page by its structure, and reads it to you.

steps.say: go to the behaviour and ecology section

steps.narrator: Everything you can click has a number, or you can just say its name.
Anything else goes to an AI that reads the page and clicks for you.

steps.say: open the comments on the top story
what are people saying about it?

end.heading: Navi
lines: Speech recognition runs on your computer
Built for people who can't use a mouse or see the screen
